raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your manufacturing team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify what you need from Cedar Systems.

During this meeting, we can discuss your workflow coordination and account reporting requirements, and determine the best path forward. Please let us know a convenient time to proceed.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
